translations.web: “I have only chosen you of all the families of the earth. Therefore I will punish you for all of your sins.”
translations.bsb: “Only you have I known from all the families of the earth; therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.”
translations.kjv: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will punish you for all your iniquities.
translations.asv: You only have I known of all the families of the earth: therefore I will visit upon you all your iniquities.
